'''John Marion''' (also published as '''Johnny Marion''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 I-10 Cup (August)]] on 18 August 2001 with [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Junkyard SBDs (Watto objective)]], according to Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2925">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-ahh-ya-time-for-a-beerd2925/ ahh-ya-time-for-a-beer], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 4 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-ahh-ya-time-for-a-beerd2925/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
